  function parseTable(table) {
    const rows = table.filter(r => r.some(v => String(v).trim() !== ''));
    if (!rows.length) return { rows: [], dups: 0, bad: 0 };
    const head = rows[0].map(v => String(v).toLowerCase());
    const find = re => head.findIndex(h => re.test(h));
    let pi = find(/رقم|هاتف|جوال|موبايل|تلفون|واتس|phone|mobile|tel|whats|number/);
    let ni = find(/اسم|الاسم|name/);
    let start = 1;
    if (pi < 0) {
      start = normPhone(rows[0][0]) || rows[0].some(v => normPhone(v)) ? 0 : 1;
      let best = -1, bestScore = 0;
      const width = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length));
      for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {
        const s = rows.slice(start, start + 50).filter(r => normPhone(r[c])).length;
        if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = c; }
      }
      pi = best;
    }
    if (pi < 0) return { rows: [], dups: 0, bad: rows.length };
    const seen = new Set(), out = [];
    let dups = 0, bad = 0;
    for (const r of rows.slice(start)) {
      const p = normPhone(r[pi]);
      if (!p) { bad++; continue; }
      if (seen.has(p)) { dups++; continue; }
      seen.add(p);
      out.push({ phone: p, name: ni >= 0 ? String(r[ni]).trim().slice(0, 60) : '' });
    }
    return { rows: out, dups, bad };
  }

  }
